question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

JAIL - ALIJ-LIAJ

ZEAL - ELAZ-LAEZ
solution:

JAIL - ALIJ-LIAJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78883facf5f3385d8db558011956bfb7189f06f28bd080dd23585315b301b5ab.png] 

ZEAL - ELAZ-LAEZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c82a94ec5afb9b86631b32bb28068b0bf25b86a883c1328852ab6f77d8dda49.png]

**Option 2) BORE - OERB - EROB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a1c09820dba6cbf919ac37ece5eddc507942e2d7b32c7466cd69fda4f28f372.png]
